summary: This study looks at how different diabetes medications affect fat tissue in people with Type 2 Diabetes, a condition where the body has trouble handling sugar. Researchers are testing three different drugs called pioglitazone, empagliflozin, and semaglutide over a six-month period. The study is currently Recruiting with a target enrollment of 60 participants. Karolinska Institutet is the sponsor for this clinical trial.
